name: NWA Next
tagline: New eats, events & openings across Northwest Arkansas. If it’s worth leaving the house for, it’s here.
description: New eats, events and openings across Benton and Washington counties in Northwest Arkansas: Bentonville, Rogers, Springdale, Fayetteville, Farmington and the towns around them. Sources and photo credits on every story.

newsletter.name: The NWA Next newsletter
newsletter.pitch: New openings, things to do and what’s changing across Northwest Arkansas, straight to your inbox.

tips.pitch: Know about a new restaurant, a shop opening or an event people should hear about? Send it our way, or email hello@nwanext.com.
